description:
Agent action via gh api; no PR. Do it right after the C2 PR merges.

1. Read ruleset 15611785 and save the JSON in the item context.
2. Remove only the `landing` entry from the required status checks. Change nothing else.
3. Read the ruleset back and record the result.
4. Run scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py against the live state. Expect only the landing difference; site-split-53 then removes it from the approved list.
